description: This source file implements survey report calculations and report pushing functionalities for a Wi-Fi management system, including raw and averaged survey data processing, memory management for survey records, and interaction with a DPP (Device Provisioning Protocol) reporting subsystem.

methods.name: int survey_report_calculate_raw(sm_survey_cache_t * cache,survey_type_t survey_type,ds_dlist_t * result)
methods.description: Calculates raw survey data by copying sample records from survey caches into the result list.

methods.name: int survey_report_calculate_average(sm_survey_cache_t * cache,survey_type_t survey_type,ds_dlist_t * result)
methods.description: Calculates average survey data by averaging sample records and inserting the result into the list.

methods.name: int survey_dpp_report_free(dpp_survey_report_data_t * report)
methods.description: Frees the survey report data list, releasing memory for each record based on report type.

methods.name: int sm_survey_report_push_to_dpp(sm_survey_cache_t * cache,wifi_freq_bands_t freq_band,survey_type_t survey_type,reporting_type_t report_type,unsigned int * report_counter)
methods.description: Generates survey reports (raw or average) and pushes them to the DPP subsystem, updating counters and cleaning cache.

methods.name: int survey_report_counter_publish_cb(void * args)
methods.description: Publishes survey report counters for each radio interface and resets counters.

ctags.name: sm_survey_report_push_to_dpp
ctags.signature: (sm_survey_cache_t * cache,wifi_freq_bands_t freq_band,survey_type_t survey_type,reporting_type_t report_type,unsigned int * report_counter)
